question:
Select the option that rectifies the spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

It has been a usual __ocurrence__ for a few days now.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **occurrence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"occurrence"** means an event or an incident that happens or takes place. (घटना)

 
 
• **Example:** The occurrence of thunderstorms is common in this region during the summer.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. occurrence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
